SDL3-CS patch release with the GPU alpha-to-coverage API fix and rebuilt native package families.

## Package Versions

| Package family | Version |
|----------------|---------|
| `SDL3-CS` | `3.4.16.2` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>` | `3.4.16.2` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Image` | `3.4.6.11` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Mixer` | `3.2.4.10` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.TTF` | `3.2.2.10` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Shadercross` | `3.0.0.10` |

## Changes

- Exposed the typed `GPUMultisampleState.EnableAlphaToCoverage` property ([#303](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/303)).
- Bundled native license and patent notices in every platform package ([#305](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/pull/305)).
- Bundled LGPL source archives and build provenance for the affected Mixer and Shadercross packages ([#306](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/pull/306)).

Applications should update `SDL3-CS` and all platform-native package families to the versions shown above.
